name: blog
description: Posts collection + Lexical code highlight + /blog routes + RSS feed
postInstall:
Manual edits required. Open src/payload.config.ts and:
  1. import Posts from "@/collections/Posts" + LexicalCodeFeature() from "@/features/lexicalCode/feature.server"
  2. add Posts to the `collections` array
  3. add LexicalCodeFeature() to the `features` array on lexicalEditor()

If you also want /blog in your sitemap, add the entries from `src/app/sitemap.ts` (see recipes/blog/README.md).

NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is used to build absolute URLs in OG tags and the RSS feed.
